detail.longDescription:
Very much enjoying working through "Crafting Interpreters"  (craftinginterpreters.com). I feel like I should say thanks to @munificent@mastodon.social 😄 

I'm working on implementing the first part (the Lox tree-walk interpreter, "jlox" in the book) in Zig, trying to write idiomatic Zig rather than doing a like-for-like translation from the original Java.

https://codeberg.org/hgrsd/lokz in case anyone wants to follow along or needs some motivation to work through the book too.

#interpreters #programming #zig
